The plan — every candidate concept, its target misconception and evidence — lives in docs/catalogue.md; see that file for why the two are separate. A widget marked shipped there must appear here, and vice versa. This is now the ONLY place a widget height is recorded; it used to be three, and deleting the embedders closed that seam.

widgets.title: Where the bell curve comes from
widgets.blurb: Each row of pegs nudges a ball one step left or right; where it lands is the sum of those nudges. Drop enough and you see how far many small random errors, added together, stray from zero.

widgets.title: Central Limit Theorem
widgets.blurb: Starts empty. Draw one sample at a time and watch its observations collapse to a mean that falls into the pile below — which goes normal whatever the population looks like, with spread σ/√n.
